method: Use the official ClientModuleSystem and getStaticModules over real built bundle registrations; then resolve exact official CLI-installed package roots and repeat. Artifact require uses only the native seed/module table, never a Node fallback.

reproduction.command: DSH_SOURCE=<built official runtime> KAOGONG_TEST_TOOLS=<development tools> tsx scripts/check-client-module-artifacts.mjs <retained fd5bd30 clean archive>
reproduction.error: client-modules: require("zod") missed the module table

buildGate: scripts/build-release.mjs invokes scripts/check-client-module-artifacts.mjs after all three product builds
releaseGate: scripts/check-platform-release.mjs invokes the same check with --installed-profile after installed bytes and public types are verified

release.dependencyMode: existing public dependency links; products installed from exact archives

limits: This is actual official factory materialization in Node with JSDOM, not Cordis entry activation or browser rendering.
Official platform imports receive inert CSS module bindings; style fidelity, input, native messages and physical IME remain browser gates.
No Host/model teaching request; real teaching, streaming, permission, Stop and AI generation remain unverified.
The minimal module graph does not certify every optional plugin injection or hot replacement combination.
No native core edit, user profile copy, credential, conversation, private source document or raw screenshot included.
